context_policy.policy: Analytic continuation, immutable centre128 RGB/CFA/sigma, independent halo noise. Score same32pixel centre as before; no reflection/resizing.

data.conditioning: Same40base features and32observed correlation cues, both branches trainable in both arms.

policy.distribution: Log-uniform frequency/amplitude; uniform direction/phase/DC; two plane waves.

sampling.selection: Fresh independent ID stream; rejection on declared frequency/amplitude strata only in candidate. No validation pixels/parameters used.

texture_augmentation.policy_scope: Base generator parameter law; quotas and any colour flips recorded separately; no independent new data claim for matched carriers.

clean_fixed_point.scope: Every positive-noise training exposure; clean CFA with the same observed-sigma field.
clean_fixed_point.target: Zero CFA correction on clean signal, no RGB interpolation compensation.
clean_fixed_point.normalization: Same noisy RGB reference energy and tempered floor as the data term.

data.noise_gate_policy: Each positive level: RGB MSE full/parent<=.98, opponent full/parent<=1, full/without_correction RGB<=1; weak/edge gradient>=.95 parent. Zero noise retains original12gates, new mixed and historical20/80.
data.training_policy: Both arms learn the same observed correlation branch from identical2048-step initializers, fresh Adam0.00025,512steps, fixed losses and replayed nontexture exposures. Same natural-sign frequency/amplitude stratification in both arms, independent fresh content streams16000000/20000000. Replication study, no winner selection, known controls only. No scores used to select data or weights.

checkpoint_policy.boundary: After completed Adam step only; restart partial microbatch from last committed checkpoint.
checkpoint_policy.selection: One atomic latest checkpoint, no validation scores or best-checkpoint selection.
checkpoint_policy.state: CPU model, Adam, completed step, losses, exposure counts, torch CPU RNG; data/noise draws derive deterministically from step.

limits: Independent Gaussian CFA noise with variance a*max(clean signal,0)+b, before demosaicing; not a sensor calibration.
Sigma estimated from observed signal and known simulation coefficients, not from clean truth.
Noisy bilinear reference in tempered loss; its energy includes noise as well as content.
Three-sigma bounded front correction; joint fine tuning can alter the trunk, cfa_front freezes it and skips gradient-free zero-noise anchors.
Frozen parent has fewer training steps; disabling correction in the trained model isolates the front-end contribution but is not an independently optimized witness.
Same procedural families and fixed4phase generator, not photographic validation.

structure_preservation.policy: Single-projection structure supervision in both arms; only statistics projection trainability differs.

lineage_exclusions.scope: All initializer contents, all fresh training contents of both arms and consulted fine truths; no reserved generation.

warm_start.optimizer: Fresh Adam in both arms; moments not inherited.

continuation.data: Both arms learn the same observed correlation branch from identical2048-step initializers, fresh Adam0.00025,512steps, fixed losses and replayed nontexture exposures. Same natural-sign frequency/amplitude stratification in both arms, independent fresh content streams16000000/20000000. Replication study, no winner selection, known controls only. No scores used to select data or weights.

plan.policy: Current arithmetic and both current weights on immutable previously observed inputs/criteria; all prior failures retained. Regression, not independent confirmation.
limits: Procedural content only, not camera/photographic qualification.
Weak0.008amplitude transfer fully reported but not required to be unbiased at low SNR.
Three positive-noise fields paired across models; zero-noise inputs are not independent replicates.
